speaker: Nora
text: We are still targeting next Thursday for launch, but only if the critical bug is fully closed.
text_zh: 我们目前仍以周四发布为目标，但前提是关键 bug 必须已经完全关闭。

speaker: Ethan
text: Engineering owns the bug fix and regression testing.
text_zh: 工程团队负责 bug 修复和回归测试。

speaker: Maya
text: Marketing will prepare the public announcement draft once legal has reviewed the wording.
text_zh: 法务审阅完措辞后，市场团队会准备对外公告初稿。

speaker: Lena
text: Please do not publish anything until legal approves the final language.
text_zh: 在法务批准最终措辞之前，请不要发布任何对外内容。

speaker: Nora
text: One open question is whether legal turnaround will affect the launch date.
text_zh: 还有一个待确认问题：法务审核时长是否会影响发布日期。
